page.notes: The index numbers at the left of each line are marginal chapter numbers; they are given inline above. Printed page number absent; running head absent. Some Greek-letter-free Latin reconstructed where print is small; doubtful readings include "Gaudeo de iis" and "Vos imitatores", which are read with moderate confidence. The middle column's first line "Quorum Deus venter est" is the tail of an entry from the previous page.
